target: Windows x64 / C++20 / Vue; no Maa runtime or MaaDeps

binaries.purpose: Official standalone OpenCV Windows headers/import libraries/runtime; replace MaaDeps build, not the WVD recognition algorithms.
binaries.installation: Extract only into project-owned dependency directory; never run a system-wide installer. Do not copy fonts or unrelated modules into deliverable.

binaries.purpose: Native C++ CPU inference only; reuse audited PP-OCR model/dictionary contracts. No CUDA or DirectML package.
Pinned Android input-control server only. Host codec must match this version; no scrcpy desktop UI/video/audio stack.

sources.purpose: Pinned wire-protocol reference/adaptation, control_msg and server reader; do not build or launch another desktop controller.
Vendor only OCR algorithm core with notice, adapt to locked OpenCV/ORT. Do not ship demo, bundled old binary dependencies, or another OCR process/service.

reuse.action: Keep existing verified project dependency; no new framework.
Use configured MuMu adb executable after local identity/version/hash check. Do not replace system or emulator adb or kill its global server.
Use installed vendor capture SDK/DLL and verified ABI. Inspect current local SDK/old binding; no unverified download or redistribution. Never use MaaController as fallback.

Copy exact existing verified model/dictionary bytes into independent resource bundle with provenance and all model preprocessing settings. Do not require Maa SDK or Maa cache at runtime; do not claim zh-Hant from English model.
Retain current package-lock and locked Node/npm; no frontend framework substitution.
